content:
Rae (People Ops): Heads-up: for the upcoming PDX onsite (May 18-21) we're trialing an on-site, staffed pop-up childcare room at the PDX hub. Goal: reduce barriers for caregivers who want to attend but can't find daytime care. Quick details below and RSVP link.
Maya (Facilities): TL;DR: staffed childcare (ages 6mo-8yrs), open 8:30am-5:30pm each onsite day, capacity 12 kids/day. Certified caregivers from Lilac Childcare will run it in the conference wing (Rm 204).
Rae (People Ops): Signup link (first-come): https://rwd.co/pdx-popup-kids. Please register child name, age, emergency contact, preferred days. Priority to employees attending onsite; partners/family members not attending may be waitlisted.
Tam (Eng): Amazing! Any cost to employees?
Jordan (Finance): Subsidy: Redwood covers base staffing and supplies. There's a nominal per-child administrative fee of $25/day to reserve a slot (to avoid no-shows) 11. We will invoice via payroll deduction or company card option on the signup form. Fee waived for hardship cases 1 DM People Ops.
Lilac Childcare (Vendor Bot): Providers on-site are licensed, background-checked, and CPR/First Aid certified. Please upload child's allergy info and authorized pickup list in the form. No meds will be administered except pre-specified EpiPens with written consent.
Rae (People Ops): Health & safety: proof of age (ID/photo), signed waiver + emergency contact required at drop-off. Temperature checks on arrival. If your child is sick, please don't bring them 1 we will refund the admin fee for same-day cancellations with notice.
Tam (Eng): What about infants and nursing parents?
Maya (Facilities): We have a private nursing room adjacent to the childcare space with lock, fridge, and comfortable chair. Nursing parents can step in as needed; please note in the form if you'll use the nursing room.
Rae (People Ops): Accessibility & special needs: if your child has specific support needs, DM me at Rae and we'll coordinate a one-on-one aide or approved accommodations.
Jordan (Finance): Contractors: this pilot is for Redwood employees only due to liability and insurance. Contractors should use external care options and can apply for our usual childcare stipend (submit receipts).
Tam (Eng): Cancellation policy? What if I register but then my travel changes?
Rae (People Ops): Full refund of admin fee if you cancel 48+ hours before the day. For same-day cancellations we will try to fill spots from the waitlist and refund if filled; otherwise no refund unless hardship.
Lilac Childcare (Vendor Bot): Drop-off/pickup: staff will sign children in/out. Authorized adults only. Photo ID required at pickup. We will keep a daily activity log that parents can view via a shared link.
Rae (People Ops): To enroll: fill the form by May 1 -> https://rwd.co/pdx-popup-kids. We have 12 slots/day for 4 days (48 total spots). If demand exceeds capacity we'll open a waitlist and consider repeating the pilot for the next onsite.
Tam (Eng): Thank you team 1 super helpful. Signed up for my kid.
Rae (People Ops): Follow-up email will include the waiver PDF, sample daily schedule, provider bios, allergy form, and the payment options. Ping @Rae (People Ops) for edge cases; Lilac will monitor questions on the signup page.
